authored_by: independent evaluator (Claude subagent without access to the product's code or earlier sets), acting as the customer's analytics team
frozen: Written before any run of the product on it; to be committed before its first run and never edited after.
purpose: Held-out questions scored against definitions the customer certified first (eval/tiered/proof_v14_customer_definitions.json), as in an onboarded deployment.
reference: Computed by eval/tiered/proof_v14_references.py from the raw tables, consistent with the customer definitions.
phrasing: The first phrasing is how an executive or analyst would ask; the second is explicit.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong; an unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many inpatient admissions did our hospitals have in 2027?
Count inpatient admissions at our four hospitals (one per stay, in-progress and completed versions merged) with an admit date in 2027.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was our inpatient admission volume in 2028?
Number of inpatient stays at WH-HOSPITAL-0 to WH-HOSPITAL-3 admitted in calendar year 2028, counting each encounter once.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many patients did we admit as inpatients in 2029, counting admissions not people?
Count of inpatient admissions (encounters of type inpatient, one per encounter_id) at our four hospitals with admit date in 2029.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Break down 2028 inpatient admissions by hospital.
For each of our four hospitals, the number of inpatient admissions with an admit date in 2028.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Show our 2028 inpatient admissions by quarter.
Inpatient admissions at our four hospitals in 2028 grouped by quarter of admit date (Q1 to Q4).

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many distinct patients were admitted to our hospitals in 2029?
Count distinct patient_id with at least one inpatient admission at our four hospitals with admit date in 2029.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was our average length of stay in 2027, in days?
Mean inpatient length of stay in days (discharge date minus admit date, same-day stays = 1) for discharges from our four hospitals in 2027, one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What was ALOS for 2029 in days?
Average length of stay in days over inpatient discharges at our four hospitals with discharge date in 2029, to one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Compare average length of stay by hospital for 2028, in days.
For each of our four hospitals, mean inpatient length of stay in days for discharges in 2028, one decimal.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What share of 2028 discharges stayed six days or longer?
Share of inpatient discharges from our four hospitals in 2028 with length of stay of at least 6 days, as a share to 4 decimals.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What were the top five reasons for admission in 2029?
Top 5 ICD-10 3-character categories of the principal diagnosis on inpatient admissions at our four hospitals admitted in 2029, with counts.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: How many inpatient discharges did we have in 2028?
Count of inpatient stays at our four hospitals with a discharge date in 2028.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: What share of our 2029 discharges went to a skilled nursing facility?
Among inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2029, the share with disposition skilled_nursing_facility, 4 decimals.

questions.domain: inpatient volume and length of stay
phrasings: Give me the 2028 discharge disposition breakdown.
Count of 2028 inpatient discharges at our four hospitals by disposition group (home, skilled_nursing_facility, expired, other).
What was the payer mix of our inpatient admissions in 2028?
Share of 2028 inpatient admissions at our four hospitals by the patient's line of business in member_month for the admit month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
How many Medicare inpatient admissions did we have in 2027?
Count of 2027 inpatient admissions at our four hospitals where the patient's member_month line of business in the admit month is medicare.
What did the ED payer mix look like in 2029?
Share of 2029 ED visits at our four hospitals by the patient's member_month line of business in the arrival month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
What was our 30-day readmission rate in 2027?
All-cause 30-day readmission rate: index inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2027 (excluding deaths) readmitted to any of the four 1-30 days after discharge / index discharges, 4 decimals.
What was the all-cause readmission rate for 2028?
Share of 2028 index discharges (inpatient, our four hospitals, not expired) followed by an inpatient admission at our hospitals within 1 to 30 days, 4 decimals.
How did our readmission rate come out in 2029?
30-day all-cause readmission rate for index discharges in 2029 at our four hospitals, by index discharge date, 4 decimals.
Show 30-day readmission rates by hospital for 2028.
For each of our four hospitals (index hospital), the 30-day all-cause readmission rate for 2028 index discharges, 4 decimals.
Break down the 2029 readmission rate by payer.
30-day all-cause readmission rate for 2029 index discharges at our four hospitals, grouped by the patient's line of business in the index admit month (uninsured when none), 4 decimals.
How many ED visits did our hospitals see in 2027?
Count of emergency department encounters (one per encounter_id, versions merged) at our four hospitals with arrival date in 2027.
What was ED volume for 2028?
Number of ED visits at WH-HOSPITAL-0 to WH-HOSPITAL-3 with arrival in 2028.
How many emergency visits did we have in 2029?
Count ED encounters at our four hospitals arriving in calendar 2029.
What was median ED length of stay in 2028, in hours?
Median time from ED arrival to departure in hours across all ED visits at our four hospitals arriving in 2028, one decimal.
How long was the typical ED visit in 2029, in hours?
Median ED arrival-to-departure time in hours for all ED visits at our four hospitals in 2029, one decimal.
For ED patients who were admitted in 2029, what was the median ED time in hours?
Median ED arrival-to-departure hours for 2029 ED visits at our four hospitals with disposition admitted or inpatient_admission, one decimal.
Median ED time in hours for treat-and-release patients in 2028?
Median ED arrival-to-departure hours for 2028 ED visits at our four hospitals not admitted and not placed in observation, one decimal.
What share of 2029 ED visits lasted six hours or more?
Share of ED visits at our four hospitals arriving in 2029 with arrival-to-departure time of at least 6 hours, 4 decimals.
What percent of ED visits turned into admissions in 2028?
Share of 2028 ED visits at our four hospitals with disposition admitted or inpatient_admission, 4 decimals.
How often did ED visits go to observation in 2029?
Share of 2029 ED visits at our four hospitals with disposition observation, hospital_observation or observation_for_mobility, 4 decimals.
What were the top five ED diagnoses in 2028?
Top 5 ICD-10 3-character categories of the principal diagnosis on ED visits at our four hospitals in 2028, with counts.
How many observation stays did we have in 2029?
Count of observation encounters (one per encounter_id) at our four hospitals starting in 2029.
How long did observation patients stay on average in 2028, in hours?
Mean observation hours (start to end time) for observation stays at our four hospitals starting in 2028, one decimal.
What was our inpatient mortality rate in 2027?
Inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2027 with disposition expired / all 2027 inpatient discharges, crude, 4 decimals.
What was in-hospital mortality for 2028?
Crude inpatient mortality: share of 2028 inpatient discharges at our four hospitals that ended in death (disposition expired), 4 decimals.
Inpatient mortality rate for 2029?
Share of inpatient discharges at our four hospitals with discharge date in 2029 whose disposition is expired, 4 decimals.
Show inpatient mortality by hospital for 2028.
For each of our four hospitals, crude inpatient mortality rate for 2028 discharges, 4 decimals.
How many sepsis admissions did we have from 2027 through 2029?
Count of inpatient admissions at our four hospitals admitted 2027-2029 with any EHR diagnosis in ICD-10 A40, A41 or R65.2.
What was the average length of stay for sepsis patients in 2027-2029, in days?
Mean length of stay in days for sepsis inpatient stays at our four hospitals discharged 2027-2029, one decimal.
How many heart failure admissions did we have in 2028?
Count of inpatient admissions at our four hospitals admitted in 2028 with principal diagnosis in ICD-10 category I50.
How many HF admissions in 2029?
Inpatient admissions at our four hospitals in 2029 whose principal diagnosis is I50.*.
What was average length of stay for heart failure patients in 2029, in days?
Mean length of stay in days for heart failure (principal I50) inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2029, one decimal.
What was our heart failure 30-day readmission rate over 2027-2029?
Share of heart failure index discharges (principal I50, not expired) at our four hospitals in 2027-2029 readmitted for any cause to our hospitals within 1-30 days, 4 decimals.
What was in-hospital mortality for heart failure patients over 2027-2029?
Share of heart failure (principal I50) inpatient discharges at our four hospitals in 2027-2029 with disposition expired, 4 decimals.
How many members did the plan cover in 2027?
Count distinct patient_id with at least one member month in 2027.
How many member months did we have in 2028?
Count of member_month rows with a month in 2028.
Break down 2029 member months by line of business.
Count of member months in 2029 grouped by line_of_business.
How many Medicaid members did we have in 2028?
Distinct members with at least one 2028 member month whose line of business is medicaid.
What were acute admissions per 1,000 members in 2028?

Acute inpatient admissions from counted payer claims (type of bill 011x, distinct patient and admission date) in months the member was enrolled in 2028, per 1,000 member-years (events / member months x 12,000), one decimal.
Admits per thousand for 2029?
Members' acute inpatient admissions (counted institutional claims, type of bill 011x, distinct patient + admission date, enrolled months) in 2029 per 1,000 member-years, one decimal.
What was our members' ED visit rate per 1,000 in 2028?

ED visits from counted payer claims (place of service 23 or a line with revenue code 045x or CPT 99281-99285; distinct patient + service date), in enrolled months of 2028, per 1,000 member-years, one decimal.
How many diabetic members did we have in 2028?
Members with at least one 2028 member month and at least one counted payer claim in 2028 with a diagnosis in ICD-10 E10, E11 or E13.
What share of our diabetic members got an HbA1c test in 2029?
Among 2029 diabetic members (as defined), the share with a counted payer claim line for CPT 83036 or 83037 dated in 2029, 4 decimals.
What was the HbA1c poor control rate among diabetics in 2028?
Share of 2028 diabetic members whose latest current HbA1c lab result in 2028 is above 9.0% or who have no result in 2028, 4 decimals.
How many of our members had heart failure in 2029?
Distinct 2029 members with at least one counted payer claim in 2029 carrying a diagnosis in ICD-10 category I50 (any position).
What did the plan pay in medical claims in 2028?
Sum of net paid dollars on counted payer medical claims (excluding voids, duplicate submissions and superseded originals) with service_from in 2028.
Break down 2029 medical paid by line of business.
Net paid dollars on counted payer medical claims with service_from in 2029, grouped by the claim's line_of_business.
What was our medical PMPM in 2027?
Medical paid dollars on counted payer claims incurred in members' enrolled months in 2027 / 2027 member months, dollars to 2 decimals.
What was medical cost per member per month in 2029?
Counted payer medical claim net paid dollars in 2029 enrolled member months / 2029 member months, to the cent.
What was total PMPM, medical plus pharmacy, in 2029?
(Medical paid on counted claims + net pharmacy plan paid) incurred in 2029 enrolled member months / 2029 member months, dollars to 2 decimals.
What was pharmacy PMPM in 2028?
Net plan paid on counted pharmacy claims (paid and recouped, one per rx_claim_id) by fill month in members' enrolled 2028 months / 2028 member months.
Show medical PMPM by line of business for 2028.
For each line of business on the member month, 2028 medical paid in those member months / those member months, dollars to 2 decimals.
What share of 2029 medical spend went out of network?
Share of net paid dollars on counted payer medical claims with service_from in 2029 where network_status is out_of_network, 4 decimals.
Which five diagnosis categories drove the most medical spend in 2029?
Top 5 ICD-10 3-character categories of the principal diagnosis on counted payer medical claims with service_from in 2029, by net paid dollars.
What share of plan medical claims were denied in 2028?
Among counted payer medical claims with service_from in 2028, the share whose final status is denied or denied_upheld, 4 decimals.
How many prescriptions did the plan pay for in 2028?
Count of paid pharmacy claims (one per rx_claim_id, latest version; excluding rejected and reversed) with fill_date in 2028.
What was total pharmacy spend in 2029?
Net plan paid dollars on counted pharmacy claims (paid plus recouped, one per rx_claim_id) with fill_date in 2029.
What was our generic dispensing rate in 2028?
Paid pharmacy fills in 2028 with formulary_tier generic / paid fills with a recorded tier (generic, brand, specialty), 4 decimals.
What were the top five drugs by plan spend in 2029?
Top 5 drug_name values by net plan paid dollars on counted pharmacy claims with fill_date in 2029.
What was our initial denial rate in 2027?
Among claims our billing office submitted (claim_adjudication, medical_claims) with service date in 2027, the share whose first adjudication was denied, 4 decimals.
Initial denial rate for 2028 dates of service?
Share of our billed claims with 2028 service dates that were denied on first adjudication, 4 decimals.
What was the initial denial rate for our hospitals' claims in 2029?
Initial denial rate for billed claims with service organization one of our four hospitals and service date in 2029, 4 decimals.
What was our final denial rate in 2028?
Share of our billed claims with 2028 service date whose final (last non-reversal) adjudication status is denied, 4 decimals.

Among our billed claims with 2029 service dates that were denied on first adjudication, the share whose final status is paid, 4 decimals.

For each payer on the first adjudication, the initial denial rate of our billed claims with 2028 service dates, 4 decimals.
How many claims did we bill for 2029 dates of service?
Count of distinct claim_id in our billing feed (claim_adjudication, medical_claims) with service date in 2029.
How much were our hospitals paid on 2028 claims?
Sum of payer_paid_delta_cents in dollars across all adjudications of billed claims from our four hospitals with 2028 service dates.
What was our no-show rate in 2027?
Appointments scheduled in 2027 with final status no_show / (no_show + kept, where kept = fulfilled, arrived or attended), 4 decimals.
How often did patients miss appointments in 2029?
No-show rate for appointments scheduled in 2029: no_show / (no_show + kept), 4 decimals.
How many appointments were completed in 2028?
Count of appointments scheduled in 2028 with final status fulfilled, arrived or attended.

Distinct patients with at least one social_need row dated in 2028.

Distinct patients with any positive social_need row in 2028 / distinct patients with any social_need row in 2028, 4 decimals.

Distinct patients positive for need food in 2029 / distinct patients with a food row in 2029, 4 decimals.

Fully loaded cost per inpatient discharge from the cost accounting system for our four hospitals in 2028.

Count inpatient admissions at our four hospitals with an admit date in 2024.

The Leapfrog safety grade assigned to each of our four hospitals in 2029.
